description: Defines a MathBlock node for a rich text editor, including parsing, rendering, commands, keyboard shortcuts, input rules, and paste rules for math blocks.

classes.name: MathBlock
classes.description: A custom node for handling math blocks within the editor, supporting insertion, parsing, rendering, and input/paste rules.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides command to insert a math block into the editor.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcut for inserting a math block.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Adds input rule to convert specific input pattern into a math block.

methods.name: addPasteRules
methods.description: Adds paste rule to recognize pasted math content enclosed in $$$ delimiters.
